title: Re-pointing a received vendor bill line does not offer an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = one tracked part, quantity 4, set inactive in Setup. [Part-B] = one tracked part, quantity 4, active.
  • Data: [Bill-1] = a received vendor bill (vendor invoice) for [Vendor-1] with one line [Vend-1].
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Vendors, click "New Vendor", type Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL BILL Vendor"), click "Save & Close". [Vendor-1] = that vendor.
  2. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BILL PART A), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BILL-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  3. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BILL-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BILL PART A).
  4. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BILL PART B), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BILL-02), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  5. [Part-B] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BILL-02); [Desc-B] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL BILL PART B).
  6. Go to Work Orders, click "New Work Order"; in Customer click Add and create a customer (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL BILL Customer"); in Asset click Add and create a unit (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BILL-UNIT"); click Create.
  7. [WO-1] = the work order number shown at the top left (e.g. S2-1234).
  8. On [WO-1] click "New Line", type Title (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL BILL line"), click "Save & Close". [Line-1] = that line. Click "Approve" on [Line-1].
  9. On [Line-1] open the line's ⋮ menu, click "Request part", type a new number in Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BILL-VEND-01) and press Tab, pick Source "Vendor", Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Vendor [Vendor-1], Cost (e.g. $8.00), Sell Price (e.g. $16.00), click "Save Part". [Vend-1] = that number.
  10. On [WO-1] open the Parts tab and order [Vend-1] (its "Order" action). Go to Parts → Purchase Orders: a new purchase order for [Vendor-1] holds [Vend-1]. [PO-1] = its number.
  11. Open [PO-1], click "Receive", type an invoice number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BILL-INV), the delivered quantity 1, Cost $8.00 and Sell $16.00, then click "Receive". [Bill-1] = that invoice number.
  12. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  13. Check the setup worked: Parts → Vendor Invoices lists [Bill-1] with the line [Vend-1]; [Part-A] is on the Inactive tab and [Part-B] on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Vendor Invoices and open [Bill-1].
  2. On the line [Vend-1], open the control that changes which part the line points to.
  3. Type "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BILL-0" in its part lookup.
  4. Close the lookup without picking anything.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: [Part-B] is offered and [Part-A] is not.
  • Step 4: The line still points to [Vend-1].
